name: Do I need a professional to install a handheld showerhead?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a professional to install a handheld showerhead?

acceptedAnswer.text: While many basic handheld showerhead installations can be a DIY project, hiring a professional general contractor is recommended for several reasons. Professionals ensure correct sealing to prevent leaks, proper mounting of wall brackets, and address any unexpected plumbing issues that may arise. For more complex setups, such as those requiring new drilling into tile or rerouting water lines, professional expertise guarantees a secure and leak-free installation, protecting your bathroom from potential water damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: A professional ensures correct sealing, proper mounting, and handles unexpected plumbing issues, especially for complex installations.
